title: 第十一章 觉醒药剂-《末世入侵：我在副本里面当NPC》
content:
第(1/3)页

    听到爻雪说竟然需要收集一千枚晶核，苏辰看着她，声音冷冽的问道：“你是不是知道了什么？”

    闻言，爻雪歪了歪脑袋。

    我知道了什么？这人是不是想多了？

    不过她倒是没有更正苏辰的想法，转身朝着货架的方向走去。

    之前赵洁和苏辰他们都买了不少的食物，尤其是苏辰，买的东西足足装满了一购物车，爻雪现在需要将已经清空的地方补上。

    她朝着货架的最深处走去，原本平整的墙体随着她的靠近，在墙壁上竟然出现了几道金色的线，这些线形成了一道门的形状，下一秒，这道门缓缓打开。

    门的另一边是仓库，目前只有爻雪这个主人才有权进入。

    进入仓库之后，里面的空间十分的巨大，大到什么程度呢，抬头甚至都看不到房顶，周围整齐的堆满了各式各样的物资。

    这么大的仓库，难怪之前在建造的过程之中，她购买的那些建筑材料被消耗了那么多。

    爻雪的手里推着购物车，将需要补充的物资全部都放进购物车里面。

    片刻之后，爻雪从仓库里面走出来，手里还推着一辆放满了物资的购物车。

    此时她的游戏商店里买的大多是各种容易储存的食物，比如面包、方便面、饼干等，水则是末世前最便宜的那种瓶装水。

    别看所有的货架都被摆得满满当当的，但实际上，能吃的也就那几种，不过这倒不是爻雪舍不得拿出更多的食物来，毕竟那么多东西，她就算是有个无底洞的胃，一天二十四小时不间断的吃，一辈子也吃不完，主要还是游戏商店的等级限制了她。

    商店里面虽然能够照明，但并没有通电，自然也就没有冰箱了，没有冰箱保鲜，肉类放不久，还有就是水果和蔬菜，也都存不久。

    仓库里的食物还能保鲜，一旦拿出来，用不了多久就会变蔫。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Hearing Yao Xue say that he needed to collect a thousand crystal nuclei, Su Chen looked at her and asked in a cold voice: "Do you know anything?"

Hearing this, Yaoxue tilted her head.

What do I know?Is this person overthinking?

However, she did not correct Su Chen's idea, and turned around and walked towards the shelves.

Zhao Jie and Su Chen both bought a lot of food before, especially Su Chen, who filled a shopping cart with enough food. Now Yaoxue needs to make up for the empty space.

She walked toward the deepest part of the shelf. As she approached, several golden lines appeared on the originally flat wall. These lines formed the shape of a door. The next second, the door slowly opened.

On the other side of the door is the warehouse. Currently, only the owner, Yaoxue, has the right to enter.

After entering the warehouse, the space inside is very huge. How big is it? You can’t even see the roof when you look up. All kinds of materials are neatly piled around.

With such a large warehouse, it’s no wonder that so much of the building materials she purchased were consumed during the construction process.

Yaoxue pushed the shopping cart in her hand and put all the supplies that needed to be replenished into the shopping cart.

A moment later, Yao Xue walked out of the warehouse, pushing a shopping cart filled with supplies.

At this time, most of what she buys in the game store is a variety of foods that are easy to store, such as bread, instant noodles, biscuits, etc. The water is the cheapest bottled water before the end of the world.

Although all the shelves are full, in fact, there are only a few kinds of food that can be eaten. However, this is not because Yaoxue is reluctant to take out more food. After all, there are so many things. Even if she has a bottomless stomach, she can eat 24 hours a day and she will not be able to finish them in her lifetime. The main reason is that the level of the game store limits her.

Although there is lighting in the store, there is no electricity. Naturally, there is no refrigerator. Without a refrigerator to keep food fresh, meat will not be stored for a long time, and fruits and vegetables will not be stored for a long time.

The food in the warehouse can still be kept fresh, but once it is taken out, it will become wilted in a short time.
